children.text: Lumen Filter removal in the 5 micron test was 93 percent.
Ember Filter removal in the 5 micron test was 88 percent.

root_proposition.text: Lumen Filter removed more particulate than Ember Filter in the 5 micron test because Lumen achieved 93 percent and Ember achieved 88 percent.

sources.content: Lumen Filter measured efficiency result was ninety-three percent.
Five micron particulate test result for Ember Filter: removal efficiency 88 percent.
Lumen Filter removal in the 5 micron test used a particulate fixture marked 93 percent during setup; the mark was not an efficiency result.
Lumen Filter removal in the 5 micron test was labeled 93 percent on the particulate protocol revision page, not as a measured efficiency.
Lumen Filter removal in the 5 micron test was recorded as 93 percent humidity during particulate setup, not removal efficiency.
Ember Filter 5 micron particulate test protocol included an 88 second stabilization step.
